answer: Each key must reserve a dedicated 3-GiB memory partition for 13 epochs and answer eight beacon-derived random reads per epoch within 220 ms. Validators verify controller counters and compare page-fault fingerprints; keys sharing seven of eight rare faults merge into one payout identity. A wander may leave a wharf beneath a cedar, but every extra fake needs another partition and 104 timely proofs, so 1,000 clones reserve 3 TiB and answer 104,000 reads. Two misses erase rewards, slash a 100-credit bond, and freeze linked keys for six epochs.
